section.title: Document content
section.p: This guide provides detailed technical instructions for installing, configuring, and managing the BACnet driver within the , covering topics such as BACnet protocol fundamentals, network and device setup, point configuration, server and device management, BACnet/SC (Secure Connect), EDE file integration, alarm handling, exporting objects, and troubleshooting, with a focus on supporting systems integrators who need to implement and maintain BACnet-based building automation solutions using and controllers.
